verified_facts.text: The hotel sits mid-mountain in Silver Lake Village at Deer Valley Resort, just steps from the chairlifts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Goldener Hirsch is located at 7520 Royal Street East in Silver Lake Village at Deer Valley Resort, offering a mid-mountain setting just steps from the chairlifts

verified_facts.text: The hotel combines a Bavarian-inspired inn with modern residences designed by architect Tom Kundig.
verified_facts.excerpt: Goldener Hirsch seamlessly blends a charming Bavarian-inspired inn with sleek modern residences designed by award-winning architect Tom Kundig.

verified_facts.text: The property was founded in 1992 by the Eccles family of Utah.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property was founded in 1992 by prominent philanthropic Utah family the Eccles

verified_facts.text: The hotel was inspired by its namesake hotel in St. Moritz, Switzerland.
verified_facts.excerpt: It was inspired by its namesake hotel in St. Mortiz, Switzerland

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop pool and an infinity-edge hot tub with views of the Wasatch Mountains, both open to guests year-round.
verified_facts.excerpt: Goldener Hirsch has a heated rooftop pool and infinity-edge hot tub with views of the surrounding Wasatch Mountains. Both are available to hotel guests year-round

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers private ski lockers, a Ski Concierge, ski valet and on-snow storage in Silver Lake Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Goldener Hirsch offers private ski lockers, a dedicated Ski Concierge, ski valet and convenient on-snow storage in Silver Lake Village.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers complimentary transportation within a four-mile radius.
verified_facts.excerpt: Goldener Hirsch offers complimentary transportation within a four-mile radius of the hotel

verified_facts.text: Historic Main Street in Park City is about five minutes away by the hotel's complimentary shuttle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Historic Main Street is approximately five minutes away and accessible via the hotel’s complimentary shuttle.

verified_facts.text: The Hirsch restaurant has a fireside setting with hand-carved wood details, embroidered velvet furnishings and murals of woodland scenes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather fireside amidst hand-carved wood details, embroidered velvet furnishings and murals of woodland scenes

verified_facts.text: The Kitz offers outdoor seating on the veranda or in the adjoining Antler Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering additional outdoor seating on the veranda or in the adjoining Antler Lounge, The Kitz provides the perfect spot for a mid-mountain snack or a heartier meal.

verified_facts.text: The wine list is anchored by Austrian wines, with selections from Jura, Savoie and Alsace.
verified_facts.excerpt: our list is anchored by Austrian wines, joined by selections from Jura, Savoie and Alsace

verified_facts.text: The Residences are one to three-bedroom homes with private balconies and chef's kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: house one to three-bedroom residences with private balconies, chef’s kitchens, and gracious dining areas

verified_facts.text: The suites and guestrooms in the original Inn have antique furnishings, arched doorways and wood furniture imported from Austria.
verified_facts.excerpt: each alpine-styled suite and guestroom in the original Goldener Hirsch Inn is charmingly distinct with antique furnishings, arched doorways and wood furniture imported from Austria

verified_facts.text: The Goldener rooms and suites have original artwork of Austrian landscapes and marble baths with dual vanities and walk-in rain showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: feature original artwork depicting Austrian landscapes and wood desks that complement the spacious marble baths with dual vanities and walk-in rain showers

verified_facts.text: Guests can book a half- or full-day ski experience with an Olympic ambassador of Deer Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a half- or full-day experience with one of six Olympic ambassadors, complete with access to the Ski School lane at every chairlift.

verified_facts.text: Experiences include fly fishing, dogsledding and snowmobiling in the Wasatch Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Head out for a day of fly fishing in high-altitude rivers, or find adventure dogsledding or snowmobiling the scenic backcountry trails of the mighty Wasatch Mountains.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers hands-on culinary experiences such as pretzel making, tastings and cocktail classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: hands-on culinary experiences such as pretzel making, tastings and cocktail classes

verified_facts.text: A dry sauna is on the top floor of The Residences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in our dry sauna, which can be found on the top floor of The Residences.

verified_facts.excerpt: Goldener Hirsch has a residence rental program that is extremely family-friendly with flexible sleeping arrangements, welcome kits for the kiddos, and babysitting services.
